verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agent mode can edit files across a workspace and cloud agents can plan/execute tasks autonomously from natural language descriptions (e.g., docs-2, docs-3, docs-6, docs-8), supporting multi-file feature/bug implementation. However, community evidence is thin on this specific multi-file agentic capability, and existing critical commentary (e.g., comm-10) raises concerns about vague 'fix the bug' prompts being unreliable, suggesting real-world results are inconsistent.
